name: bbcmicrobit-cpp
description: Build CODAL C++ programs for the BBC micro:bit, directly in VS Code without external compilers and toolchains needed.

scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:integration:desktop
scripts.test:integration: npm run manager && npm run build && npm run build:integration && vscode-test-web --quality stable --headless --extensionDevelopmentPath=. --extensionPath=.vscode-test/manager/extension --extensionTestsPath=./test/integration/dist/index.js ./test/workspace
scripts.test:integration:desktop: npm run manager && npm run build && npm run build:integration && node config/desktop.mjs --test --extension=.vscode-test/manager/extension
scripts.serve: npm run manager && npm run build && vscode-test-web --quality stable --browser=none --port=3000 --extensionDevelopmentPath=. --extensionPath=.vscode-test/manager/extension ./test/workspace
scripts.chrome: npm run manager && npm run build && vscode-test-web --quality stable --browser=chromium --extensionDevelopmentPath=. --extensionPath=.vscode-test/manager/extension ./test/workspace
scripts.desktop: npm run manager && npm run build && node config/desktop.mjs --extension=.vscode-test/manager/extension

bbcmicrobit-cpp.build.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns for files under the workspace folder that Build leaves out, on top of `#files.exclude#`. The default keeps out the `libraries` and `build` folders of a CODAL checkout, whose sources the extension already carries prebuilt.
